description: This file contains unit tests for the OpenClaw project, specifically testing the behavior of main session key retrieval from a JSON configuration.

classes.name: WebChatMainSessionKeyTests
classes.description: A struct containing various test methods to verify the behavior of main session key retrieval from JSON configurations.

methods.name: config get snapshot main key falls back to main when missing
methods.description: Test that the main session key defaults to 'main' when the key is missing in configuration.

methods.name: config get snapshot main key trims and uses value
methods.description: Test that a valid mainKey value with whitespace is trimmed and used correctly.

methods.name: config get snapshot main key falls back when empty or whitespace
methods.description: Test that an empty or whitespace mainKey results in fallback to 'main'.

methods.name: config get snapshot main key falls back when config null
methods.description: Test that null config results in fallback to 'main'.

methods.name: config get snapshot uses global scope
methods.description: Test that when scope is set to 'global', the key reflects that.
